title: Social Life : Forms and Dynamics

questions.question: Give one example of a personal problem that can be better understood using sociological imagination. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Sociological Imagination Example: Unemployment—seen not as personal
  • failure but linked to economic structure. [A]/[CO1]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss two major social problems that emerged during the Industrial Revolution and how they attracted the attention of early sociologists. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Industrial Revolution Problems: Urban poverty and child labour; early
  • sociologists studied their social causes. [An]/[CO1]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine the role of individualism in modern social life. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Individualism in Modern Life: Encourages self-expression but weakens
  • traditional community ties. [E]/[CO2]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Briefly explain the term “historical materialism”? / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Historical Materialism: Marx’s concept that material conditions and economic
  • base determine social structure. [K]/[CO2]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain one key difference between class structure in urban areas and social structure in tribal areas. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Class vs. Tribal Structure: Urban areas—economic class hierarchy; tribal areas
  • —kinship-based egalitarianism. [U]/[CO3]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Briefly describe the role of women’s organizations in Kerala in addressing gender-based issues in the 21st century. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Women’s Organisations in Kerala: Kudumbashree and Vanitha Commission
  • promote gender justice. [U]/[CO3]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain in your own words what is meant by 'lived culture'. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Lived Culture: Everyday practices through which people experience and
  • reproduce culture. [U]/[CO4]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe how habitus influences individual behaviour. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Habitus: Bourdieu’s concept of internalized dispositions shaping social
  • behaviour. [U]/[CO4]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Distinguish between ascribed and achieved status with one example of each. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Ascribed vs. Achieved Status: Birth-based (ascribed)—caste; merit-based
  • (achieved)—profession. [U]/[CO1]

questions.question: Describe the focus of phenomenology in understanding social reality. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Phenomenology: Focuses on subjective meanings individuals attach to
  • experiences. [U]/[CO2]

questions.question: Elucidate on the role Panchayati Raj Institutions play in the development of rural areas? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Panchayati Raj Role: Decentralizes power; enables local participation and
  • development. [U]/[CO3]

questions.question: Describe how the Enlightenment emphasis on science and rationality contributed to the emergence of the social sciences. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:

  • impressions in social interaction. [U]/[CO2]
